name: Ibeno Beach
description: A long shoreline on the Atlantic coast and one of Akwa Ibom's best-known natural destinations.
highlight: Plan a relaxed coastal visit and check local sea and weather conditions before entering the water.
imageAlt: Ibeno Beach and Atlantic shoreline in Akwa Ibom

name: National Museum, Oron
description: A museum in Oron associated with regional cultural heritage and collections from southeastern Nigeria.
highlight: Allow time to explore the displays and confirm current opening arrangements before travelling.
imageAlt: Exterior of the National Museum in Oron
sourceName: National Commission for Museums and Monuments

name: Godswill Akpabio International Stadium
description: A major sports venue in the state capital, known for hosting football and other public sporting events.
highlight: Check the stadium's official channels for event dates, visitor access and ticket information.
imageAlt: Front view of Godswill Akpabio International Stadium in Uyo

name: Ibom Tropicana Entertainment Centre
description: A leisure and entertainment development in Uyo, included in the state's visitor and recreation landscape.
highlight: Confirm which facilities and activities are open before setting out.
imageAlt: Ibom Tropicana Mall and entertainment complex in Uyo

name: Ibom Plaza
description: A central public landmark and familiar meeting point in Uyo.
highlight: Pair a brief stop with nearby city-centre errands or dining.
imageAlt: Ibom Plaza roundabout in central Uyo

name: ARISE Park
description: A landscaped public park in Uyo that offers an open-air setting for a walk and a pause in the city.
highlight: Visit in daylight and follow any on-site guidance about access and park use.

name: Amalgamation House
description: A historic building in Ikot Abasi associated with the 1914 amalgamation of Northern and Southern Nigeria.
highlight: Use a local guide or reliable historical source to understand the site in its colonial-era context.
imageAlt: The historic Amalgamation House in Ikot Abasi

name: Bridge of No Return
description: A memorial site connected with the history of the transatlantic slave trade in the region.
highlight: Approach the site with respect for its solemn history and verify local access before travelling.
imageAlt: The Bridge of No Return memorial site in Ikot Abasi

name: Pioneer Graveyard, Qua Iboe Church
description: A historic burial ground associated with the early Qua Iboe mission and the pioneer community in Ibeno.
highlight: This is a place of remembrance; check access locally and visit with respect for the community.
imageAlt: Historic graveyard of the pioneer Qua Iboe Church community in Ibeno
sourceName: Qua Iboe Church pioneers' graveyard — Wikimedia Commons

name: Pioneer Qua Iboe Church
description: A historic church in Ibeno connected with the Qua Iboe mission and the faith history of the local community.
highlight: This remains a place of worship; contact local church representatives before arranging a visit.
imageAlt: Exterior view of the pioneer Qua Iboe Church in Ibeno
sourceName: Pioneer Qua Iboe Church — Wikimedia Commons

name: Udo Udoma Lake
description: A lake in Uyo offering a quieter natural setting within the state capital.
highlight: Check local access and conditions before visiting; leave the area as you found it.
imageAlt: Udo Udoma Lake in Uyo, Akwa Ibom State

name: Wellington Bassey Road roundabout
description: A road landmark in Uyo that gives a glimpse of the city's everyday movement and streetscape.
highlight: Use the roundabout as a city landmark, not a pedestrian attraction; follow local road-safety guidance.
imageAlt: Road roundabout on Wellington Bassey Road in Uyo
sourceName: Wellington Bassey Road roundabout — Wikimedia Commons

name: Uyo Post Office
description: A civic landmark in Uyo and a point of interest for visitors exploring the city centre.
highlight: Plan a city walk in daylight and ask locally about pedestrian access around the building.
imageAlt: Uyo Post Office building in Akwa Ibom

name: Ibeno coastal walk
description: A relaxed shoreline walk is one way to experience Ibeno's Atlantic coast and open beach landscape.
highlight: Check local sea and weather conditions, stay clear of unsafe water, and follow community guidance.
imageAlt: Atlantic coast at Ibeno, shown in a second view of the beach

name: Ikot Abasi heritage trail
description: A flexible half-day outing can connect historic landmarks in Ikot Abasi, including Amalgamation House and the Bridge of No Return.
highlight: Arrange local guidance and transport, allow time between sites, and approach memorial places respectfully.
imageAlt: Amalgamation House, one of the historic landmarks on an Ikot Abasi heritage outing
